label: World Day of Peace
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Peace, 1 January.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/peace. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'LVIII Giornata Mondiale della Pace 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/peace.index.html). The Paul VI shelf opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale della Pace 1968' (https://www.vatican.va/content/paul-vi/it/messages/peace.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: Lent message
gloss: The annual papal message for Lent.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/lent. Titles are dated, never numbered: 'Quaresima 2025: Camminiamo insieme nella speranza' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/lent.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Communications Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Communications Day.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/communications. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'LIX Giornata Mondiale delle Comunicazioni Sociali, 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/communications.index.html). The Paul VI shelf opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale delle Comunicazioni Sociali, 1967' (https://www.vatican.va/content/paul-vi/it/messages/communications.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Day of Migrants and Refugees
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Migrants and Refugees.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/migration. Titles carry an Arabic ordinal rather than a Roman one: 'Messaggio per la 110ª Giornata Mondiale del Migrante e del Rifugiato 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/migration.index.html). First year not verified. Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Mission Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Mission Day (Giornata Missionaria Mondiale).
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/missions. Titles on the Francis shelf are dated, not numbered: 'Messaggio per la Giornata Missionaria Mondiale 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/missions.index.html). Earlier shelves not checked. Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Youth Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Youth Day.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/youth. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'XXXIX Giornata Mondiale della Gioventù, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/youth.index.html). First year not verified. Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Day of Prayer for Vocations
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Prayer for Vocations.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/vocations. Titles carry an Arabic ordinal: 'Messaggio per la 62a Giornata Mondiale di Preghiera per le Vocazioni 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/vocations.index.html). First year not verified. Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Day of the Sick
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of the Sick, 11 February.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/sick. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'XXXII Giornata Mondiale del Malato, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/sick.index.html). First year not verified. Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Day of the Poor
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of the Poor.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/poveri. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'VIII Giornata Mondiale dei Poveri, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/poveri.index.html). First year not verified. Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Day for Grandparents and the Elderly
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day for Grandparents and the Elderly.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/nonni. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal, and the shelf opens at 'I Giornata Mondiale dei Nonni e degli Anziani, 2021' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/nonni.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Children's Day
gloss: The papal message for World Children's Day.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/bambini. One entry as of the check, carrying a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'I Giornata Mondiale dei Bambini, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/bambini.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Food Day
gloss: The annual papal message to the FAO for World Food Day, 16 October.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/food. Titles are dated, not numbered: 'Messaggio per la Giornata Mondiale dell'Alimentazione 2024 (16 ottobre 2024)' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/food.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Day for Consecrated Life
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day for Consecrated Life, 2 February.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/consecrated_life, normalised to the slug pattern. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'XXIX Giornata Mondiale della Vita Consacrata - Festa della Presentazione del Signore (1° febbraio 2025)'; the 2023 entry is titled without one, which is why `ordinal` is optional even inside a numbered series (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/consecrated_life.index.html). First year not verified. Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Day of Prayer for the Care of Creation
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Prayer for the Care of Creation, 1 September.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/cura-creato. Titles are dated, not numbered: 'Messaggio del Santo Padre in occasione della Giornata Mondiale di Preghiera per la Cura del Creato [1° settembre 2024]'; a single entry names the 'VI Giornata Mondiale' (2020), so the day is counted even though the shelf does not number its titles. The shelf opens with the letter of 6 August 2015 instituting the day (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/cura-creato.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Tourism Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Tourism Day, 27 September.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/tourism, present for John Paul II. Titles are dated, not numbered: 'Messaggio per la Giornata Mondiale del Turismo (27 settembre 2004)'; the shelf runs 1982-2004 (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/tourism.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.

label: World Literacy Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Literacy Day (Giornata Mondiale dell'Alfabetizzazione).
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/literacy, present for John Paul II. Titles are dated, not numbered: 'Giornata Mondiale dell'Alfabetizzazione 2003'; the shelf runs 1979-2003 (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/literacy.index.html). Verified 2026-09-11.
